notes.title: Version 1.2 Update! - Achievements, Controller Support, and More!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=AbUYVI-A3LY;full][/previewyoutube]

Color Soul: Memories is back with another update! I am pleased to present version 1.2, which adds the ability to play with a controller instead of a keyboard, achievements to collect (and a small reward if you get them all), and graphical updates such as a new dash particle effect and keyboard/controller icons! Hope you enjoy!

[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Added full controller support.[/b] Connect a controller to your computer, and you should automatically be taken through a short configuration setup and be ready to go.

[*] [b]Added achievements.[/b] Various achievements will be now awarded through gameplay challenges. Collect them all for a small reward.

[*] [b]Added a settings menu.[/b] This replaces the configuration launcher that used to be activated before starting the game. This now also includes controller configuration settings.

[*] [b]Added a dash particle effect in battles.[/b] Note for weaker computers this effect is partially disabled on Low Graphics Quality and completely disabled on Very Low Graphics Quality in the settings menu.

[*] [b]Created a new application icon.[/b]

[*] [b]Added keyboard/controller button prompt graphics.[/b]

[*] [b]Updated credits slightly.[/b]

[*] [b]Changed the method of accessing a secret ever so slightly.[/b]

[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the fishing minigame that would cause it to run at inconsistent speeds on different computers.

[*] Fixed a game softlock with the fishing minigame caused by rapidly interacting with it after full completion.

[*] Fixed an issue with battles that caused the enemies to move at inconsistent speeds on different computers.

[*] Fixed diagonal player movement being faster than it should have been.

[*] Fixed a typo in the Red Volcano area. Shoutout to Prokube on Youtube for pointing that out XP
[/list]
